asset: Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium fidelity pass (generated bowl sections, 2021 SEZ, rim details, exterior textures, videoboard)
policy: Photographs below were inspected as REFERENCE ONLY. No pixels from any of them are shipped (textures are procedural canvas painters in lib/campus/context-textures.ts and lib/campus/blocks/b09-stadium/board-face.ts). Values are tagged measured (scan / LiDAR / official dimension) or reference-interpreted / estimate. Pre-2021 photographs are used only for parts unchanged since (east side, north end), never for the 2021 South End Zone.
